text:
Priya D: kicking off MarketBridge HSM pilot with SecureVault (HSM/KMS) + several IdP partners. Goals: BYOK import, SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, and marketplace listing pilot. Target GA: 2026-06-10. Owners: SSO Lars, SCIM Carmen, KMS Lars (backup Carmen), Partner PM Priya. Call out immediate blockers and network needs.

Lars H: ack. SSO plan: support SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows, HTTP-POST binding. We'll require signed assertions in prod. Will provide SAML metadata endpoint + cert rotation guidance. Question: partner expects multiple signing certs; we support that.

Carmen R: SCIM plan: accept PATCH, PUT, GET, LIST with paging. Mapping: userName->email, externalId->id, groups array accepted. Recommend rate limit 8 req/s with burst 40. Will draft mapping doc.

Lars H: KMS/HSM notes: SecureVault requires KMIP and PKCS#11 support. BYOK imported as wrapped key blob (RSA-OAEP-256). We need to publish CSR template for HSM client certs; vendor requests SAN with CN=marketbridge-client. I'll upload CSR example.

Priya D: Ops ask: partner requires allowlist of 4 IPs for HSM egress, not CIDR. @ops-bot can you schedule a rule change once we have IPs? Also marketing embargo: 2026-06-02. Legal signoff needed by 2026-05-01.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Network change ticket created: NET-9210. Awaiting partner IP list. Planned window: 2026-04-12 03:00 UTC for test egress rules.

Carmen R: UI/UX: surface provisioning status and last_sync_time, plus a small retry hint when SCIM rate limited. We'll also show BYOK state: imported, active, rotated_at.

Lars H: test matrix: 1) BYOK import using wrapped blob 2) live key rotate with zero downtime 3) SAML SSO (IdP and SP flows) 4) SCIM group push + paging 5) fallback to software KMS. I'll draft acceptance tests.

Priya D: Legal note: partner requires minimal custody language; legal draft due 2026-04-28. Also confirm marketplace tenant model: single shared listing first, then dedicated offer for enterprises. Preference: start shared.

Lars H: Ops risk: HSM vendor uses port 5696 and mutual TLS; confirm outbound TCP 5696 allowed to exact IPs. Also prefer encrypted KMIP session and client cert mutual auth.

Carmen R: Compatibility concern: some IdPs send NameID as transient. We'll add fallback to email claim and document compatibility matrix.

Priya D: Action items summary: 1) Lars upload CSR + SAML metadata + acceptance tests by 2026-04-05 2) Carmen publish SCIM mapping + UI mocks by 2026-04-07 3) Priya collect partner IPs and coordinate legal + marketing timelines 4) ops-bot create network change and test window. Weekly sync Fridays 09:30 PT starting 2026-03-28. React :white_check_mark: when you see.

Lars H: :white_check_mark:

Carmen R: :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: ops-bot: NET-9210 updated with target window and owner.
